core: Plasma membrane phospholipid translocation and polarized membrane protein trafficking
qualifier: scrambling, membrane repair and apical/raft delivery
name: Plasma membrane phospholipid scrambling, repair and apical trafficking
rationale: Members concern plasma membrane lipid asymmetry (flippases, scrambling, ANO6), membrane repair, cell volume/mechanical responses and apical/raft protein delivery including CFTR, which sets it apart from bile-acid transporter, apoptotic-cell clearance and pancreatic duct confusables.

qualifier: including inborn errors of cycle enzymes and transporters
name: Urea cycle and arginine-ornithine metabolism, including inborn errors
rationale: All members cover urea cycle enzymes, their inherited deficiencies, arginine/ornithine/citrulline metabolism and transport and ammonium handling, whereas confusables centre on glutamate, glutamine, aspartate and proline metabolism.

qualifier: inhibitory Gi/Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic signalling
name: GPCR regulation of adenylate cyclase via inhibitory Gi/Gz signalling
rationale: Members describe GPCR control of cAMP production, dominated by adenylate cyclase inhibition through Gz and alpha-2 adrenergic receptors, distinct from confusables on catecholamine secretion, PKA/PDE downstream events, Gq calcium signalling and muscarinic/purinergic receptors.

name: Polyamine metabolism and tryptophan-kynurenine-derived NAD+ synthesis
rationale: Members span putrescine/spermidine/spermine synthesis, oxidation and transport plus tryptophan-kynurenine catabolism feeding nicotinate/NAD+ metabolism; confusables have only one of these halves (polyamine/hypusine/methionine salvage or NAD(P) transport/redox).

name: Mitochondrial gene expression and tRNA processing and modification
rationale: Members cover mtDNA replication, mitochondrial transcription, RNA processing, ribosome assembly and translation together with nuclear and mitochondrial tRNA maturation and modification, unlike confusables focused on nucleolar rRNA modification, selenocysteine/readthrough or protein modification.

qualifier: myocardial wall (trabecular/compact) morphogenesis, regeneration and hypertrophy
name: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation and growth in myocardial wall morphogenesis
rationale: Members regulate cardiac muscle cell proliferation, differentiation, survival and growth in trabecular/compact myocardium, regeneration and stress hypertrophy, whereas confusables concern early heart tube, second heart field, septal and endocardial morphogenesis.

core: Heat shock response and chaperone-mediated protein refolding
name: HSF1 heat shock response and chaperone-assisted protein refolding
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, heat acclimation and chaperone refolding (including UPRmt and ER folding), distinguishing it from stress granule, ATF4/ATF6/IRE1 UPR, de novo chaperonin folding and aggrephagy confusables.

qualifier: promotion of endothelial proliferation/migration and angiogenic growth factor production
name: Sprouting angiogenesis promotion and angiogenic growth factor production
rationale: Members are mostly positive regulators of endothelial proliferation, migration, branching and sprouting plus control of VEGF, FGF and TGF-beta2 production, unlike confusables centred on angiogenesis inhibition, Tie2/VEGFR2 receptor signalling or vessel remodelling and leukocyte adhesion.

qualifier: growth restraint and nephric duct-ureter formation
name: Kidney growth control and nephric duct-ureter morphogenesis
rationale: Members regulate metanephros/mesonephros development, kidney size and restraint of renal proliferation and apoptosis, plus nephric duct and ureter formation, while confusables focus on ureteric bud branching or metanephric mesenchyme and nephron differentiation.

core: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures
name: Monocyte and dendritic cell surface signatures, CD1 lipid presentation
rationale: Members are mostly monocyte/DC (and some lymphocyte) surface-marker modules with CD1/MHC class Ib lipid antigen presentation and butyrophilins, distinct from MHC class II peptide presentation, T cell costimulation and neutrophil/innate confusables.

name: Inherited defects of proteoglycan linker tetrasaccharide synthesis
rationale: All three members are disorders of the galactosyl/glucuronyl transferases that build the shared GAG-protein linker region, whereas confusables concern heparan, keratan, chondroitin or dermatan sulfate chain synthesis.

core: Catecholamine and monoamine reuptake and catabolism
name: Catecholamine reuptake and MAO/COMT-mediated monoamine degradation
rationale: Members cover dopamine/norepinephrine transport and reuptake (with transporter defects) and monoamine oxidative deamination and COMT degradation, distinct from confusables on catecholamine synthesis and vesicular release or serotonin synthesis.

qualifier: stalled-ribosome rescue and stress granule dynamics
name: Ribosome-associated quality control and stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members split between stalled-ribosome quality control (ZNF598/RQT, RQC nascent-chain degradation) and stress granule assembly/disassembly, which together set it apart from aggrephagy, N/C-degron, proteasome-regulation and ERAD confusables.

qualifier: heart tube, second heart field and septation
name: Heart tube, second heart field and cardiac septum morphogenesis
rationale: Members describe cardiogenesis from heart tube patterning and second heart field to ventricle formation and atrial/ventricular septation, distinguishing it from outflow tract, coronary, valve/endocardial cushion and conduction system confusables.

qualifier: gamma-chain, IL-6, IL-10 and IL-12 cytokine families
name: Interleukin JAK-STAT signalling by gamma-chain, IL-6, IL-10 and IL-12 families
rationale: Members are interleukin receptor signalling through JAK-STAT (and SHC/ERK) for IL-2/7/9/15/21, IL-6/LIF/CNTF, IL-10/20 and IL-12/23/27/35 families, unlike confusables on type I/II/III interferons or IL-11/IL-37 signalling.

name: Activin signalling regulation and pituitary gonadotropin secretion
rationale: Members cover activin signalling and its modulation by follistatin and TGFBR3 plus positive regulation of FSH and LH secretion, separating it from TGFBR3-general, ovarian follicle and Sertoli cell confusables.

core: Oncogenic receptor tyrosine kinase mutants and inhibitor resistance
qualifier: KIT, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK and FGFR
name: Oncogenic KIT/PDGFR/FLT3/ALK/FGFR mutants and kinase inhibitor resistance
rationale: Members describe signalling by mutant, fused or amplified KIT, PDGFR, FLT3, ALK, LTK and FGFR kinases and their TKI binding and resistance, distinct from normal FLT3/EPO/STAT5 cytokine signalling and ERBB2/EGFR cancer variant confusables.

name: VEGF, Tie2 and neuropilin control of sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members cover positive and negative regulation of sprouting angiogenesis, endothelial proliferation, migration and survival with VEGF/VEGFR2, neuropilin and Tie2 receptor signalling, unlike confusables on endothelial junctions, endothelial fate/vasculogenesis or vessel remodelling.

qualifier: Golgi organization and Rab/ARF GTPase regulation
name: Golgi organization and Rab/ARF-regulated vesicle traffic
rationale: Members cover COPII/COPI transport, intra-Golgi and Golgi-endosome-lysosome traffic, Golgi assembly/disassembly and Rab/ARF regulation, distinguishing it from ER translocation, folding and ERAD confusables.

name: Mucosal antibacterial defense by agglutination, metal sequestration and cytolysis
rationale: Members describe host defense against bacteria at mucosae via metal sequestration, bacterial agglutination, attachment and cytolysis, whereas confusables are defined by defensins, antimicrobial peptide production and antifungal or antinematode responses.

name: Dishevelled-level Wnt signalling, including WNT5A calcium non-canonical branch
rationale: Members cover receptor-proximal Wnt events (DVL activation and degradation, AXIN recruitment, ligand antagonists, LRP5 mutants) together with WNT5A/calcium non-canonical signalling, unlike confusables on FZD ubiquitination, Wnt secretion or AXIN degradation.

name: MECP2 transcriptional regulation and sensorimotor and social behavior
rationale: Members combine MECP2 function and Rett-associated loss-of-function events with sensory, vocal, social and learning behaviours and striatum/amygdala development, distinct from locomotion/glycinergic and neuronal excitability confusables.

name: BH3-only protein activation triggering BAX/BAK-mediated cytochrome c release
rationale: Members describe BH3-only proteins (BAD, BIM, BMF, NOXA, PUMA) activating BAX/BAK to release cytochrome c, distinct from downstream apoptosome/SMAC caspase activation, MOMP regulation terms and p53 transcriptional confusables.

core: Vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic switching
name: Vascular smooth muscle phenotypic switching and SRF-driven cytoskeletal programs
rationale: Members regulate vascular smooth muscle proliferation, migration, apoptosis, differentiation and dedifferentiation with SRF target modules and vessel remodelling, distinct from endothelial shear stress, perivascular stroma and cardiac muscle confusables.

qualifier: DAP12 and macrophage proliferation and fusion
name: M-CSF and DAP12 signalling in macrophage proliferation and fusion
rationale: Members cover CSF1/M-CSF receptor and DAP12 tyrosine kinase signalling driving macrophage proliferation and fusion, distinct from osteoclast, myeloid differentiation and SIRP/phagocytosis confusables.
